Master.g1.label: Request submitted

intake.submission_channels.summary: An agency shall honor requests for identifiable public records received in person during normal office hours, or by mail or email, unless exempted by the chapter.

intake.no_required_form.summary: No official format is required to make a records request, though an agency may recommend a form or web page.

intake.no_technicality_denial.summary: An agency shall not deny a request for identifiable public records solely because the request is overbroad.

Master.g1.city_config: Which channels the city actually operates (portal / form / paper / phone) — statute constrains, city chooses.

Master.g4.label: Acknowledgment auto-sent

response.valid_response_forms.summary: The initial response must take one of five forms: provide the record; provide a website link to it; acknowledge and give a reasonable time estimate; acknowledge and request clarification with an estimate; or deny.

Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

response.time_estimate_notice.summary: When acknowledging a request rather than fulfilling it, the agency must provide a reasonable estimate of the time it will require to respond.
response.time_estimate_notice.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "reasonable estimate of the time ... to respond" from acknowledgment

Master.p3.city_config: Which data points intake must capture to estimate (page count, media, labor class).

payment.deposit_ceiling.summary: An agency may require a deposit not exceeding ten percent of the estimated cost of providing copies for a request.

clarification.clarification_process.summary: When acknowledging an unclear request, the agency may ask the requester to clarify what information is sought.
Where only part of a request is unclear, the agency must respond to the portions that are clear.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Upon request for identifiable public records, the agency shall make them promptly available to any person.
An agency shall not distinguish among persons requesting records.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester shall not be required to provide the purpose of the request, except to establish whether disclosure would violate the commercial-purpose list prohibition or another statute restricting disclosure to certain persons.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Records must be made available to any person with no residency or citizenship qualification.

fee.commercial_charge.summary: The chapter does not authorize giving, selling, or providing access to lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes, and agencies shall not do so unless specifically authorized or directed by law.

intake.reasonably_describes.summary: A request must be for identifiable records; a request for all or substantially all of an agency's records is not valid, but a request for all records on a particular topic, keyword, or name is not treated as a request for all records.

Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING
Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

special_records.third_party_proprietary.summary: An agency has discretion to notify persons named in, or to whom a requested record specifically pertains, that release of the record has been requested, except where notice is required by law.

intake.duplicate_request_denial.summary: An agency may deny a bot request that is one of multiple requests from the same requester within a 24-hour period if it establishes that responding would cause excessive interference with other essential functions.

response.extension_grounds.summary: Additional time to respond may be based on the need to clarify the request, to locate and assemble records, to notify affected third persons or agencies, or to determine whether information is exempt.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to fifteen cents per page for photocopies or printed copies of electronic records.
Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to ten cents per page for public records scanned into an electronic format.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: A reasonable charge may be imposed for copies and for use of agency copying equipment, not exceeding the amount necessary to reimburse the agency for its actual costs directly incident to copying.
An agency may charge actual copying costs only in accordance with costs it has established and published; it may establish and make available a statement of the actual costs it charges for copies.
In determining actual copy costs, an agency may not include staff salaries, benefits, or general administrative or overhead charges unless directly related to the actual cost of copying.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to five cents per each four electronic files or attachments uploaded for electronic delivery.
Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to ten cents per gigabyte for transmission of records in an electronic format.

fee.commercial_charge.summary: The chapter does not authorize giving, selling, or providing access to lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes, and agencies shall not do so unless specifically authorized or directed by law.

fee.special_service_charge.summary: An agency may impose a customized service charge for a request that requires information-technology expertise to prepare data compilations or provide customized electronic access not used by the agency for other purposes, only after notifying the requester of the charge and the reason it applies.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: An agency may not impose copying charges for access to or downloading of records it routinely posts on its public internet website.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: An agency may charge a flat fee of up to two dollars for a request as payment for the costs of providing the copies, in lieu of itemized charges.

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: Agency rules must provide for the fullest assistance to inquirers and the most timely possible action on requests for information.
custody.custodian_definition_and_role.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "most timely possible action" from request receipt

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each state and local agency shall appoint and publicly identify a public records officer to serve as the point of contact for records requests and to oversee the agency's compliance with the chapter.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: An agency may charge a flat fee of up to two dollars for a request as payment for the costs of providing the copies, in lieu of itemized charges.

intake.duplicate_request_denial.summary: An agency may deny a bot request that is one of multiple requests from the same requester within a 24-hour period if it establishes that responding would cause excessive interference with other essential functions.
